t: What remains of Holland House is in front of you, in the grounds of Holland Park. It began as an early Jacobean country house, built in 1605 by the diplomat Sir Walter Cope. In the nineteenth century it was a noted gathering place for Whigs. German firebombing in 1940 destroyed most of it, leaving the east wing and some ruins. Two people who died here, Henry Fox, the first Baron Holland, and his wife Caroline, both died in 1774. Henry was a Whig politician and the father of Charles James Fox.
